account.deleteBody: This erases your personal details, signs you out everywhere and cannot be undone. Business and enquiry records are kept in anonymised form.
account.deleteMfa: Authenticator or recovery code (if you use two-step sign-in)
account.deleteStepUp: For your security, confirm it's you: enter your password, or your authenticator code if you use two-step sign-in. If you signed up with a phone number or Google, verify your phone number first on this page.
account.onbSubtitle: Sellers use this to see who is asking. You can add more later.
